script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - DAY

JOSH (17, skinny, anxious) steps off the bus, clutches his backpack tighter. He takes deep breaths, mentally preparing himself for the day ahead. He spots the entrance to the school and hesitates, looking around.

Suddenly, he hears a voice, "JOSH!"

He turns to see MIKE (17, tall, athletic), who is also heading to the school, grinning at Josh.

MIKE: Hey man, I thought you weren't coming today.

JOSH: (nervously) I needed a break.

MIKE: (understanding) It's all good, man. But come on, we've got practice.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - LATER

Josh and Mike are on the volleyball court. The coach calls them over.

COACH (50s, stern): Josh, Mike, I need you two in the starting lineup tonight. We've got a big game against the rival school.

MIKE: (excited) Yeah, we've got this, Coach!

JOSH: (anxiously) I'll do my best.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - NIGHT

The game is in full swing. Josh and Mike are serving, their team leading by a few points.

MIKE: (whispering to Josh) You got this, man. We've got this.

JOSH: (determined) I know.

They serve, the ball goes over the net, their opponent makes a weak return. The crowd cheers as Josh smashes the ball into the ground, scoring a point for their team.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM LOCKER ROOM - POST-GAME

The team is in the locker room, showering and changing. Josh and Mike sit side by side, exhausted but elated.

MIKE: (proudly) We did it, man. We beat the rival school.

JOSH: (smiling) We did. It's all thanks to you, Mike. You really helped me out there today.

MIKE: (laughing) You're good, Josh. Don't sell yourself short.

JOSH: (gratefully) Thanks, man. I couldn't have done it without you.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - DAY

The next day, Josh is back on the bus, heading to school. He looks out the window and sees Mike waving at him. Josh smiles and waves back.

MIKE (V.O.): You know what, Josh? We're not just teammates. We're friends.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
